surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between SiCl4 and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites. The pyridine catalyst weakens the SiO{H bond through hydrogen-bonding interactions, increasing the nucleophilicity of the O atom to facilitate the attack on the electron-deficient Si of SiCl4. During the H2O half-reaction, pyridine enhances the reaction by hydrogen-bonding with H2O, making the O atom more nucleophilic to attack the surface Si atoms.
